en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

It's weird for guys to not look for 
those kinds of books in a library!

Of course, we gotta keep this 
a secret from the girls!

Adventure manga are the best!
They've got so much passion in them!

You should read all the famous 
adventure manga, Shuichi!

Since we're pals, it'd be great to read 
through some together.

Really? There are so many books here, 
there's gotta be some that interest you.

Before you start complaining, try 
looking around a bit more.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
